title.narrative: Improvement of organizational and productive capacities among cocoa producers in the Mining Triangle in Nicaragua

description.narrative: The project aims at contributing to the programme #Improvement of Organizational and Productive Capacities among Cocoa Producers in Nicaragua#s Mining Triangle# whose goal is to support food safety and sovereignty of the rural population in Autonomous North Atlantic Region of Nicaragua. The outcomes of the programme are: 1) Cocoa farmers and farmer#s organizations increase and rehabilitate planting areas while increasing sales and technical, business and organizational capabilities, 2) the production of cocoa under agroforestry systems has increased as well as the productivity and product quality production of cocoa quality of cocoa production and 3) Organisations interested in the development of the cocoa value chain (private companies, business organisations, government institutions, support institutions, and others) work coordinated within a competitiveness framework agreement and benefit from good governance among chain actors. The programme is implemented by the Ministry of the Communal Family, Cooperative and Associative Economy benefiting directly 1200 cocoa producer families with 5000 family members in the municipalities of Siuna, Bonanza and Rosita. Indirectly some additional 10.000 people will also be benefitting from the project including members of producer families, service providers, extension age
